groups.label: Main blooms
groups.blurb: The statement flowers climbing the texture wall — white orchid lines, orange lilies and warm roses.

items.role: White phalaenopsis orchids in vertical strands — the signature line flower of this installation.
Golden-orange lilies massed through the middle layer.
Sunflowers scattered along the ground layer.
Warm orange roses tucked through the upper and middle layers.
Soft pale-pink ranunculus layered along the ground.

groups.label: Yellow accents
groups.blurb: Light yellow touches bridging the warm flowers and the green mass.

items.role: Light single-petal yellow poppies dotted low.
Fine yellow daisies filling the gaps.
Yellow delphinium spikes lifting the line of the arrangement.

groups.label: Greens & trailing grasses
groups.blurb: The wild textured green base — soft trailing strands are the soul of this look.

items.role: Large soft trailing strands hanging down the wall — the soul of this installation.
Fluffy needle greenery forming the base layer.
Grey-green round leaves dotted through the greens.
Deep-green needle branches on both sides of the wall.
Compact cypress-leaf bunches shaping the two cone-like side trees.
Misty grass strands softening the edges.
